title: Word: Copilot Agent Mode edits documents through chat
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents the licensed editing capability formerly called Agent Mode, so its licence tier and prerequisites should not be described as unpublished. The licence-assignment path and command are correct, but the stated PowerShell permission requirement omits documented alternatives.
